parsed.review_summary: The edited rationale addresses all four error targets. It correctly reassesses the feedback as only minimally actionable (fixing the evidence_misread and rubric_misapplication), removes the internal contradiction by consistently characterizing the comment as lacking depth and constructive direction, and corrects the score mapping by stating the comment aligns with the lower end of the rubric without specifying a numeric score or gold label. Unrelated correct reasoning (identifying the specific weakness and citing the relevant work) is preserved, and no new evidence is introduced.
